content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. Retaliation was never framed in the acceptance letter, and Complainant was not asked about the basis of his reprisal claim, so no evidence on it was gathered. Claim 1 (no midyear review) has no investigative evidence on why the review was withheld; the Agency dismissed it on a legal theory. The Executive Officer, the second-line supervisor named as a discriminating official, has no testimony summarized. Two of the four named comparators were not supervised by the CIO and were not addressed, and Comparator 2's situation (a family member's medical need) is not comparable, so the comparator evidence is thin. The Claim 2 chronology is well documented, but the other claims and bases cannot be fairly evaluated on this record."}
